landing.subtitle: Enter site data — get aquifer depth, yield and quality guidance in seconds. Built for well drillers across Tanzania.
landing.featSub: From site inputs to a clear drill-ready assessment.
landing.feat1Desc: Combine location, geology signals and environmental data in one workflow.
landing.feat2Desc: Designed around regional conditions and field decision needs.
landing.feat3Desc: Get potential, depth range, yield and quality in a clear report card.
landing.howSub: Four simple steps from survey data to decision.
landing.step1Desc: GPS, resistivity, rock type, elevation and rainfall.
landing.step2Desc: Your data is checked and prepared for assessment.
landing.step3Desc: Depth, yield, quality and confidence in one view.
landing.step4Desc: Use the report to plan the next drilling step.
landing.faqSub: Quick answers about the Groundwater Prediction System.
landing.faq1a: It helps well drillers assess groundwater potential at a site using location and field-related inputs before drilling.
landing.faq2a: Mainly latitude, longitude, and optional values such as resistivity, rock type, elevation and rainfall.
landing.faq3q: Is the result a guarantee of water?
landing.faq3a: No. It is decision support. Final drilling decisions should still use professional judgement and local knowledge.
landing.faq4a: Drillers, field teams and organisations working on water access projects in Tanzania.
landing.faq5a: English and Kiswahili. Use the language button on the top right.
